extrinsic_single_act.note: Can count as a weak differentiator, but is circular/primitive unless an independent account fixes why its relation targets this outcome.

intrinsic_differentiator.note: Supplies a nonprimitive difference-maker but violates frozen strict-simplicity typing.

necessary_determination.note: Avoids contingent selection only if the exact-totality bridge is independently supplied; it is a C-Nec-D rather than C-Cont structure.

primitive_agent_causation.note: Preserves a primitive free selection and weak NBD, but leaves a terminal selector under strong NBD.

unmarked_contingent_selection.note: No difference-maker is supplied; fails even weak NBD.

scope: Finite case-classification audit; conditional only; not an adjudication of historical theology.
